comparison.objective: Rotate two hurdles so their feet face the runners’ approach while leaving them upright on their marks.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-object reorientation and placement with directional reasoning.
comparison.success_condition: Each upright hurdle on its marks with feet toward the start earns 0.5.
comparison.reason: Directional reorientation of sporting equipment does not exercise small-tool alignment, fracture physics, or fragment containment.
